input:
Labeled defect
- root cause: The exception-message predicate requires the regular expression to match the entire exception message.
- failure path: Given an exception message with a matching prefix followed by additional diagnostic text, the retry condition returns false and Tenacity propagates the exception without retrying.

Reviewer finding
- description: The matcher was switched from re.match (prefix match) to fullmatch (whole-string match), a behavior change the commit title does not mention.
- rationale: Trigger: retry_if_exception_message(match="Connection") and an exception whose str is "Connection refused". The old self.match.match returned a match, so the exception was retried. With fullmatch the pattern must cover the entire message, so it returns False and the exception is not retried. Impact: existing callers that rely on prefix or substring-style patterns silently stop retrying, so retries are skipped without any error.
critique: The finding says the predicate now uses fullmatch, so the pattern must cover the whole message. A prefix-matching message such as "Connection refused" therefore returns False and is not retried. This is the same mechanism and failure path as the label.
